{"bytes":324662,"code":200,"codeText":"OK","durationMs":5374,"result":"# CSS Subgrid Baseline Status\n\n## Current Status\n**Widely Available** - The subgrid feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions.\n\nAccording to the MDN documentation:\n> \"This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions. It's been available across browsers since September 2023.\"\n\n## Minimum Browser Versions\n\nBased on the \"Baseline Widely available\" designation indicating availability since September 2023, the minimum versions are approximately:\n\n- **Chrome**: 115+ (September 2023)\n- **Edge**: 115+ (September 2023)\n- **Firefox**: 119+ (October 2023)\n- **Safari**: 17+ (September 2023)\n\n## Key Information\n\nThe `subgrid` value is used with:\n- [`grid-template-columns`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/grid-template-columns)\n- [`grid-template-rows`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/grid-template-rows)\n\n### Basic Usage Example\n```css\n.grid {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr);\n  grid-template-rows: repeat(4, minmax(100px, auto));\n}\n\n.item {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-column: 2 / 7;\n  grid-row: 2 / 4;\n  grid-template-columns: subgrid;\n  grid-template-rows: subgrid;\n}\n```\n\nThe subgrid allows nested grid items to inherit track sizing from their parent grid, enabling better alignment of nested components with the main grid.","url":"https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_grid_layout/Subgrid"}
